{{Quote|I'll see you back at our quarters. If you need me, I'll be in the Geroons' shuttle.|Luke Skywalker, to Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
A [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was disguised as a '''Geroon shuttle''' during the [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]'s [[Plot to begin a war against the Vagaari Empire|plot]] to begin a [[Third Vagaari War|war]] against the [[Vagaari Empire]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The so-called Geroon shuttle first appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
